objective: 实现 provider-neutral Slow Semantic Advisor contract、Disabled/Shadow/AsyncAdvisory consumption projection与stateful async stale tests，不购买backend且不改变Runtime行为

semantic_brief.summary: Buyer：Phase 2.6 blocker migration、deep Unknown 与 UI-TARS shadow能力/authority分离证据支持Slow受控实验。Slow只解释fresh evidence含义并challenge Fast；结果必须精确绑定request/occurrence/revision，Shadow永远零行为效果。

change_principles: 先搜索async semantic/advisor/provider/assistance/correction symbols并给出REUSE/EXTEND/REFACTOR/CREATE裁决
新ISlowContainerSemanticAdvisor只有在existing Fast ISemanticProvider扩展会混合latency/result/lifecycle职责时才允许创建，并写NEW_SYMBOL_JUSTIFICATION
保留原始Slow assessment；current/stale/mismatch与Fast conflict为pure derived consumption view，不写回任何state
Disabled不得调用advisor；Shadow可调用并记录assessment，但runtime effect必须为0；AsyncAdvisory也只暴露advisory availability
不得实现provider/backend、重试队列、scheduler、cache、latest-result field、recovery或correction FSM
你不是仓库唯一执行者；不得回退或覆盖他人/用户修改，发现scope文件并发变化则停止上报Leader
acceptance: WorkResult提供existing symbol搜索和新interface buyer裁决；接口仅有AssessAsync request/cancellation/result，不暴露action/current/graph/recovery/goal methods
production contract包含Disabled/Shadow/AsyncAdvisory mode、exact evidence-bound request、confirm/challenge/correct/insufficient assessment、scene interpretation、pure consumption projection
Disabled测试证明advisor零调用；Shadow测试证明assessment可见但Current/Graph/action/recovery/completion effect标志恒为false
stateful async测试证明Fast可先完成、Slow后到；same revision confirm/challenge/correct/insufficient可见；更新fresh revision使旧Slow result stale且不得成为current
测试覆盖request/result Observation/Node/Source/Trigger/Transition/revision mismatch fail-closed，以及advertisement/transient/overlay/off-path或wrong-child interpretation
Fast/Slow conflict在derived view显式可见，Slow不直接回滚Fast、修改Current/Graph或发出recovery/action
架构Guard证明无mutable state、provider implementation/backend、DeviceAction、Goal/Plan/Recovery/Completion/Graph mutation、Agent/DriverHost dependency
targeted Slow+Fast+V2 core+legacy transition tests、Runtime Rebuild、git diff --check通过
forbidden: 禁止修改 OpenSpec、docs、WorkItem、tasks checkbox或 scope.write 之外任何文件
禁止修改现有 Fast/Semantic provider/fusion、Agent、Container、DriverHost、Traversal、Recovery、Environment 或 GoalEvidence
禁止添加具体model/API/backend/网络调用/credential/config/dependency或产品级provider选择
禁止把Slow result写入ContainerRuntimeV2State/Graph/CurrentContainer/WorldBelief或任何latest mutable slot
禁止把Slow confidence/semantic correction当world truth或直接触发rollback/revisit/reenter/reset/recover
禁止放宽stale/mismatch fail-closed或删除测试取得GREEN
escalation: 若contract必须选择具体provider/model/dependency或长期deployment/cost policy，返回REQUIRED_HUMAN_GATE
若Shadow需要修改Agent/Graph/Current/Goal才能观察，返回BLOCKED_FOR_OBSERVABILITY_WORKITEM，不扩scope
若Slow correction无法在无obligation mutation下表达，先返回contract gap，不创建Recovery FSM
若scope文件存在不明并发修改或失败指向scope外，保留现场并返回Expected/Observed/Gap/FirstDivergence/Owner
